rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
rules.requirement: This bill would prohibit the use of algorithmic devices or software to set or recommend rents for rental housing in Massachusetts.
rules.quoted_span: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
rules.conflict_note: Bill reported favorably and referred to Senate Ways and Means as of March 2026; not yet enacted.

rules.title: An Act relative to preventing algorithmic rent fixing in the rental housing market
rules.requirement: This bill would prohibit algorithmic rent fixing practices in the Massachusetts rental housing market.
rules.quoted_span: An Act relative to preventing algorithmic rent fixing in the rental housing market
rules.conflict_note: Bill reported favorably and referred to House Ways and Means as of March 2026; not yet enacted.
